description: Accelerate the split-mega med kernel's STAGE-3 twisted-factorization eigenvector computation -- the last un-attacked stage of mega_eigh_med_split_k, and the one brief-30+34 identify as the LATENCY-BOUND dominant cost. The megakernel-split lineage cracked stage-1 tridiag (brief-25, batch-windowed wash) and stage-4 back-transform (brief-22, 1.5x WIN via torch batched GEMMs); stage-3 (per-eigenvalue twisted MRRR factorization: for each of k eigenvalues, forward+backward tridiagonal recurrences DP/DM, pick a twist index, build the eigenvector by up/down substitution, normalize) has never been optimized. brief-34 measured mega_eigh_med_split_k = 33.9ms = 37.7% of shape 8; brief-30 profiled it 28ms@k352->48ms@k448 and found stage-3 is the eigenVECTOR-orth-loss source AND cost. It is the HOT kernel on shapes 2 (n352 direct) + 3/8/12 (k=352/384 inner solve), so one speedup COMPOUNDS across 4 shapes (same multiplier logic that made brief-22's back-transform split win). ATTACK OPTIONS (worker picks by profiling stage-3 first with ncu): (a) the twisted recurrences are per-eigenvalue independent but currently thread-per-eigenvalue (k threads, low ILP) -- try warp-per-eigenvalue or vectorized substitution; (b) the DP/DM forward/backward sweeps are sequential O(n) per eigenvalue -- unavoidable but the memory access (DP/DM in global scratch, n*n per matrix) may be the bottleneck vs keeping them in SMEM/registers; (c) SPLIT stage-3 out to a torch/cuSOLVER batched tridiagonal-eigenvector solve (like brief-22 split the back-transform) if the in-kernel version is launch/latency-bound -- cuSOLVER has stedc/steqr for tridiag eigenvectors; measure whether a batched torch-level tridiag solve beats the in-kernel twisted factorization at these (k,batch). Keep stages 1/2/4 intact; per-matrix residual-gated cuSOLVER fallback. Profile stage-3 on shape 8 (b640 k=384) FIRST to pick the mechanism. -O3/--use_fast_math (accepted-best flags, NOT -O2); no 'stream' substring; NVCC (contention eased -- brief-35's kernel already compiled, chain build+bench efficiently); forks best 5c66a54b3; verify 39/39 twice + quiet re-bench beats 35401. DISTINCT from brief-25 (stage-1), brief-22 (stage-4), brief-35 (k>448 reduced block for 4/10), brief-30 (orth ceiling).

t1: split stage-3 twisted-factorization into a separate full-grid kernel mega_eigh_stage3_k (one thread per (matrix,eigenvalue), B*n grid), removing it from the per-matrix CTA. Main kernel persists scaled lambda to Lamscr; lean stage-3 kernel reads scaled lambda+d/e (eigenvectors scale-invariant) and fills V. Validates 39/39. REGRESSION: geomean 46297us vs parent 35602us (+30%). Likely 630MB memset per call + extra launch + low-rank inner solve calling split kernel repeatedly. shape2=20728 shape3=121743 shape8=148320 shape11=207630 shape12=46990.

t2: drop redundant memset (substitution writes every V row) + expose mega_eigh_stage3 for isolated timing. NEUTRAL vs parent measured back-to-back under identical contention: t2 geomean=46214us vs SAME parent re-benched=46254us (the 35401/35602 numbers are quiet-run; +30% contention now from brief-35 nvcc). KEY MEASUREMENT: isolated stage3 kernel at k=384 b640 = 4663us = only 13.5% of the megakernel (main+stage3=34425us); main kernel (stages1+2+blockT) is ~87%. ncu isolated stage3 @k384 b640: DRAM=38%, compute=5%, IPC=0.23 => MEMORY-BOUND on n*n global DP/DM scratch. Brief premise (stage3=37.7%) partially refuted; stage3 real share ~13% but still worth attacking (memory-bound). shape2=20538 shape3=121645 shape8=148499 shape12=47028.

t3: warp-per-eigenvalue stage-3 with SMEM DP/DM (option a+b combined). One warp per (m,ev); lane0 runs serial fwd/bwd recurrences into per-warp SMEM (DP[n]+DM[n], no n*n global scratch); 32 lanes cooperate on twist-argmin+norm+Vwrite. Directly attacks the 38%-DRAM-bound DP/DM. Validates 39/39. NEUTRAL: isolated stage3 @k384b640=4538us vs thread-per-ev 4663us (-2.7% noise), WORSE @k352 (3857 vs 3746) and @b60 (447 vs 352). SMEM DP/DM savings offset by lost parallelism (8 chains/CTA vs 256) - lane0-serial+31idle kills latency hiding. Geomean 46250us == parent 46254us. Refutes the SMEM-recurrence direction.

t4: fused thread-per-eigenvalue stage-3 (best stage3-speed result). Keep max-parallelism thread-per-ev (warp+SMEM refuted t3), remove warp kernel; fuse global passes: twist-argmin computed DURING backward DM sweep (DM[k] in-reg, DP[k] reread) removes a full DP+DM twist scan; norm accumulated DURING substitution (v[k] in-reg) removes a full V norm-read pass. Isolated stage3 kernel: k384b640 3739us (was 4663, -20%); k352b640 3191us (was 3746, -15%); k352b60 300us (was 374, -20%). ncu k384b640: Duration 3.53ms (was 4.36), DRAM 35.5%. Validates 39/39. GEOMEAN NEUTRAL 46353us (parent 46254, contention noise): stage3 is ~3% of shapes 3/8/12 -> 20% kernel win = <1% geomean, below noise floor. shape2=20640 shape3=121722 shape8=148189 shape12=47824.

STAGE-3 explored across all 3 brief attack options; HEAD=971516775 (t4), geomean 46353us == parent 46254us re-benched back-to-back under IDENTICAL contention (the 35401/35602 figures are quiet-run; brief-35 nvcc inflates all current numbers ~1.6x -- re-bench quiet to compare). 39/39 validated TWICE (deterministic -O3/--use_fast_math). grep stream=0.

STEP-0 PROFILE (ncu, whole mega_eigh_med_split_k @ n352 b40): latency-bound -- 50% occ (reg+SMEM capped), grid 0.27 waves, 66% of stalls = CTA-barrier wait, DRAM 0.14%, uncoalesced global (8.5/32 B). Mechanism = tiny grid + serial recurrences + barrier imbalance.

KEY REFRAMING (measured, contradicts brief premise): after splitting stage-3 into its own kernel and timing it in isolation (CUDA events), stage-3 = ONLY 13.5% of the megakernel (main+stage3=34425us @k384b640, stage3=4663us), NOT 37.7%. The MAIN kernel (stages1+2+block-T) is ~87%. And the megakernel inner solve (40.8ms @k384b640) is ~27% of shape8 (148ms contended). So stage-3 is ~3% of the compounding shapes 3/8/12 -> even a 2x stage-3 win is <1% geomean, below the noise floor.

ATTACK OPTIONS -- ALL MEASURED:
 (c) torch/cuSOLVER batched tridiag eigh: DECISIVELY REFUTED -- batched dense-tridiag torch.linalg.eigh = 96880us @k384b640 = 26x SLOWER than custom stage3 (cuSOLVER has no batched tridiag path, loops syevd). Never route stage3 to torch.
 (a)+(b) warp-per-eigenvalue + SMEM DP/DM (t3): NEUTRAL-to-worse -- isolated stage3 4538us vs 4663 (-2.7% noise), WORSE @k352/b60. SMEM DP/DM savings cancelled by parallelism loss (8 recurrence chains/CTA vs 256); recurrences are inherently serial so warp-per-ev wastes 31/32 lanes.
 (b)-via-fusion (t4, BEST/HEAD): fused thread-per-ev -- twist-argmin computed DURING backward DM sweep (DM in-reg), norm accumulated DURING substitution (v in-reg), removing 2 full global passes. Isolated stage3 -15-20% (k384b640 4663->3739; k352b640 3746->3191; k352b60 374->300). ncu: Duration 4.36ms->3.53ms, DRAM 38%->35.5%. Orth PRESERVED on shapes 2/3/8/12 (orth_max 1.2e-4..8.1e-4, all << gate; eigr tiny; L sorted). 0 fallbacks. But geomean neutral (stage3 too small a share).

t1/t2 = the split isolation itself (neutral, but ENABLES isolated stage3 timing + the full-grid occupancy + the fused-pass win). Removed the redundant memset (substitution writes every V row). Persist scaled lambda via new Lamscr; eigenvectors scale-invariant.

OPEN DIRECTIONS (manager's call):
 1. Stage-3 speed alone is noise-bound -- the REAL lever is brief-30's ORTH CEILING: stage-3's orth cliff at k>384 BLOCKS shapes 4(k608)/10(k768) from the fast megakernel inner solve (stuck on cuSOLVER). A stage-3 variant that stays orthogonal at larger k would move shapes 4/10 off cuSOLVER = compounds across 5 shapes = FAR bigger than stage-3 speed. brief-30 refuted pure-torch NS re-orth; an IN-KERNEL orth-preserving twisted factorization (higher-precision pivots / re-orthogonalize clustered eigenvectors in-kernel) is unexplored and is where stage-3 work actually pays.
 2. The MAIN kernel (stages1+2+block-T) is now the isolated ~87% of the megakernel at 50% occ -- the split cleanly exposes it for a separate occupancy/tridiag attack (brief-25 territory but the split changes the surface).
 3. store-ONE-array (DM only, recompute DP into the V column) halves DP/DM DRAM but is ~same op count as t4's fusion (~7n) -- untested, marginal.
 4. quiet re-bench of t4 needed to confirm the -20% kernel win nets a small (<1%) but real geomean gain vs contention noise.
